/daily.title: Daily chess puzzle
/daily.description: Solve a new daily chess puzzle from a real game. Find the best move, explore candidate moves and practice the winning line to sharpen your tactics.

/random.title: Random chess puzzles
/random.description: Practice random chess puzzles from real games. Explore tactical themes, find candidate moves and solve winning lines at your own pace.

/quiz.title: Chess puzzle quiz
/quiz.description: Test your tactics with a chess puzzle quiz from real games. Solve each position in one try and track how your quiz rating changes as you practice.

/look-ahead.title: Look ahead: chess calculation practice
/look-ahead.description: Practice calculating three moves ahead. Find good lines in real chess positions and consider your opponent's best replies before making your move.

/games.title: Chess games to study and solve
/games.description: Browse real chess games by theme, level, opening and training focus. Replay each game, study its ideas and solve the key positions along the way.

/games/:id.title: Chess game replay and training
/games/:id.description: Replay a real chess game move by move. Explore its critical positions, compare candidate moves and practice finding the best continuation.

/library.title: Chess analysis and study library
/library.description: Analyze chess positions and games with Stockfish. Set up a board, compare candidate moves with engine analysis and save games for further study.

/my-games.title: My saved chess games
/my-games.description: Return to your saved chess games and positions. Review your analysis and continue studying in your personal Chess training library.

/sign-in.title: Sign in
/sign-in.description: Sign in to Chess training with your Google account to save games and keep track of your chess practice.

/profile.title: Your chess training profile
/profile.description: View your Chess training profile, review your practice progress and manage your account preferences.
